description: Figure 3 is a vertical grouped bar chart illustrating the results of different logical synthesis modules on the BIRD-dev dataset across three evaluation metrics. The horizontal axis contains the metric categories “Recall,” “Precision,” and “F1 Score,” arranged left to right, and the vertical axis is a numeric performance scale with labeled ticks at approximately 40, 60, 80, and 100 (linear scale, no explicit y-axis label visible). For each metric, three adjacent bars are shown corresponding to the legend entries at the top: “DIN-SQL (zero-shot)” in light blue, “TA-SQL (zero-shot)” in darker blue, and “DIN-SQL (few-shot)” in light green; the bars have value labels printed above them. For Recall, the light-blue DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar is labeled 63.58, the dark-blue TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar is 71.90, and the light-green DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar is 72.29. For Precision, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar is 88.81, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar is 91.24, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar is 92.31. For F1 Score, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar is 75.34, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar is 80.40, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar is 81.08. The bars are grouped by metric rather than sorted by value, and there is no visible special emphasis such as outlines or annotations beyond the numeric labels.
